             ADMISSION PROCEDURE SESSION 2023-24

registering themselves in the DARPAN portal of AHSEC ( https://darpan.ahseconline.in/ ). Details
of theAdmission process are available in the Darpan portal and will be updated on the college
website(https://www.guwahaticollege.org.in/Hs_first_year_admission.php).

 APPLICATION PROCEDURE
  ➢ Before admission, candidates should get their Academic Bank of Credit (ABC)
     Id by registering in the following portal: https://www.abc.gov.in/
  ➢ A candidate shall apply for admission through the Assam State Higher Education
     Admission Portal-SAMARTH PORTAL ONLY ( https://assamadmission.samarth.ac.in
     ). The link will be available on the college website as well to register and proceed with the
     further application process.
  ➢ Admission will be strictly on a merit basis. A confirmation message will be sent to the
     Samarth User ID of the respective candidate. After accepting the offer from the concerned
     Institution, a candidate will be considered as PROVISIONALLY SELECTED FOR
     ADMISSION.
  ➢ The admission committee of the college will conduct physical verification of the relevant
     documents on the day of admission. After successful verification and fee payment, the final
     admission will be confirmed.
  ➢ The candidates whose names appear in the merit list but fail to get admitted on the specified
     date will forfeit their claim.
  ➢ Reservation of seats for SC, ST(P), ST(H), OBC/MOBC, EWS, PwD, and Sports and
     Extracurricular activity quota will be done as per Assam Government regulation.




 ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
     A student who has passed the 12th standard or equivalent examination in any stream from
     a recognized institution is eligible to apply.
     Admission to the FYUGP will be based on the preference of Major, if any. In case a student
     does not want to opt for any Major, s/he will be admitted based on preferences of the
     subject combinations.
     Admission to a Programme or Major will be subject to the availability of the subject and
     capacity of a college/department.
     No student shall be eligible for admission to a Programme in any discipline under the
     FYUGP unless s/he fulfills the pre-requisites of courses as fixed by the university.

            GUWAHATI COLLEGE: A BRIEF INTRODUCTION

    “Great works are performed not by strenGth but by perseverance.”


  Guwahati College situated in the eastern part of Guwahati is one of the premier institutions of
  Assam for higher learning in the region. It has a strength of nearly three thousand students,
  who are ably guided towards the achievement of their goals, by a highly qualified and
  experienced teaching community.
  The College was started on 3rd August 1964 at Chandmari, Guwahati. Later, it was shifted to
  its permanent building in Bamunimaidam at Jyotinagar. The College has now traversed
  through half a century, successfully contributing to the upliftment of the society. It is now one
  of the most reputed Colleges of Assam where students from all over the Northeastern Part of
  India get admitted.
  Guwahati College has completed 59 glorious years of existence and was re-accredited (Cycle
  3) by NAAC with Grade B++ with a CGPA of 2.91 in 2023. The College now stands as a full-
  fledged Institution of higher learning equipped with the latest educational technology. The
  infrastructure reflects the development of the College with its well-stocked library,
  Departmental Libraries, Seminar Halls, well-equipped Laboratories, and a beautiful
  playground. The College has its own unique Anthem. At present, the College has three streams
  both in
  The Mission of the College:
  The mission of the College is to TEACH. The term here stands for:
     •      Transformation of the society through the spread of knowledge.
     •      Education of the youth and development of personality.
     •      Acquisition of skills by learners.
     •      Creation of dedicated human resources.
     •      Help in nation-building.


  The Vision of the College:
  Guwahati College has the vision to attain the status of an autonomous educational institution
  with all its stakeholders making substantial differences in our modes of thinking and patterns
  of living. The College wants to ensure that the real fruits of modern education spill over the
PROSPECTUS 2023-2024                                                         GUWAHATI COLLEGE

  confines of the classroom, resulting in the well-being of the planet and all things living.
  Guwahati College attempts to understand the social needs of the country and prepare the
  students accordingly to fill up those needs. Many of the programmes undertaken by the College
  focus on innovation and entrepreneurship with an aim to contribute its mite to national progress
  and development on all fronts.
  The College strives for the inculcation of values like justice, non-violence, equality, secularism
  and a passion for knowledge in the young minds so that they can develop a scientific and
  ethical approach to the problems of our society while not sacrificing the richness and diversity
  of our culture and heritage.
  Guwahati College is making rapid strides towards its goal of producing not only students with
  nearly flawless academic report cards but also a sensible and responsible intelligentsia who are
  well aware of the social and ethical responsibility that a truly modern education vest in them.
  Objective of the College:
     *       To encourage the students to find out their potential.
     *       To produce high quality students
     *       To produce ideal citizens for fulfilment of social obligations.
     *       To develop research culture among the students as well as faculties.
     *       To promote co-curricular activities amongst the students.
     *       Creation of Social Awareness.
     *       Inculcating Moral Values


  College Emblem:
  The College emblem with its motto is highly suggestive of the institution's mission and vision.
  In appearance, the emblem resembles a lotus in partial bloom. This highlights the Nationalistic
  spirit that prevails in college. It also suggests opportunity for the students to prosper. This
  image further emphasizes the optimistic spirit that forms the basis of the mission of the College
  -"the will to develop and improve further".
  The figure of the open book implies the propagation of education while the alternate dark and
  white lines suggest the College's endeavor to reach out to humanity in its entirety without any
  prejudice against caste, creed or colour. The earthen lamp, illuminating the surroundings to
  remove any darkness of ignorance, forms the motto of spreading the light of knowledge. The
  small dots represent the multitude that is expected to be benefitted by the propagation of
  knowledge.

  Attendance Requirements:
  ❖ To be eligible to appear at a University Examination every student has to attend a minimum
     of 75% of the lectures, practical and tutorials held during the academic session.
  ❖ The principal shall have the power to strike off the name of a student who is grossly
     irregular in attendance.
  ❖ Students remaining absent on medical grounds should submit a medical certificate from
     the appropriate authority while rejoining college. However, absence on Medical Grounds
     does not mean that they will be exempted from any kind of examination.


  Discipline:
  The college expects its student to conduct themselves in a disciplined and dignified manner in
  the college and outside. Students must follow the following rules:
  1. Students are responsible for their conduct and are prohibited from doing anything, either
     inside or outside the college that will amount to a breach of discipline or interference in the
     discipline and normal working of the college.
  2. Interference of any outside pressure group in the internal affairs of the college is strictly
     prohibited.
  3. Students are expected to have regard and consideration for each other and be respectful to
     the teachers, members of the college staff and fellow students.
  4. Unbecoming language or ungentlemanly conduct shall be severely dealt with.
  5. Students shall maintain perfect silence in classrooms and desist from disorderly behaviour.
     They are expected not to walk about or make noise in the corridors or in front of classrooms
     and must keep as quiet as possible at all times. During their free periods students should
     work quietly in the Library or Reading Room, or spend the time in the Students Common
     Room, but without causing any disturbance.
  6. Students shall take proper care of the college property, furniture and premises. They must
     not cause damage to or tamper with college property, furniture and fittings.
  7. Students shall leave their bicycles, scooters or motorcycles locked in the parking shed
     provided for this purpose. No bicycle, scooter or motorcycle shall be parked in any other
     part of the college campus.
  8. No society can be formed in the college nor shall any person be invited to address a meeting
     in the college without the permission of the Principal.

  9. Notices designed to be pasted or circulated by the students anywhere in the college
     premises shall require the approval of the Principal.
  10. Students shall not spoil or misuse the lawns or any other space of the college.
  11. Communal harmony must be maintained.
  12. Students suffering from any contagious or infectious diseases will not be permitted to
     attend the college. They will be allowed to rejoin classes only after producing a fitness
     certificate from the appropriate authority.
  13. It is mandatory for students to come to college in proper College uniform during class days
     as well as on other working days.
  14. Smoking, chewing tobacco and spitting betel-nut inside the college campus is considered
     as a punishable event.
  15. Students shall not loiter around in college uniform outside the college campus.
  16. Parents / Guardians must monitor their wards during their study in the College.


  Ragging:
  Ragging in any form is strictly prohibited within the college premises or outside the campus.
  Guwahati College is committed to provide a ragging free academic environment to the
  students. The college in principle adheres to the UGC Regulations on curbing the Menace of
  Ragging in Higher Educational Institutions, 2009 and accordingly constituted an Anti-Ragging
  committee to ensure a ragging-free campus. Any act of the following will be considered as an
  act of ragging:
  ➢ Involvement in physical assault or threat or use of physical force.
  ➢ Violation of the status, dignity, and honor of students.
  ➢ Expose students to ridicule and contempt and affect their self-esteem.
  ➢ Entail verbal abuse and aggression, indecent gestures, and obscene behavior


  Monitoring of Academic Progress:
  The Principal, Teachers, IQAC and the Academic Monitoring Cell of the college make regular
  effort during the academic session to make first-hand assessments of the academic progress of
  the students or any problems related to teaching and learning.


  Guardians Meet:
  Guardians Meet is conducted for interaction between the Principal teachers and
  parents/guardians of students. Guardians are encouraged to attend such meetings to express

                             Facilities And Features

  1. Identity Card
  An Identity Card will be issued to every student after the admission. The card displays the
  name, class, roll number and a recent passport size photograph of the student duly endorsed
  by the college authority. Students must always carry their Identity Cards to college every
  day. Every student is required to get his / her identity card renewed at the beginning of the
  new academic session. The identity card must be surrendered at the time of leaving college.
  2. Academic Calendar and class schedule
  The academic calendar is available in the college website. Time-table will be available during
  the commencement of the new session.
  3. Travelling Concession
  Students are entitled to Railway/Air concessions to and from their homes during vacation and
  for travelling on academic tours organized by the college.
  4. Students Aid Fund
  The college has instituted a student aid fund. The objectives of the fund are:
     (a)     To render financial assistance to the economically backward and deserving students
  whose father’s /guardian’s income falls below BPL norms of the Government.
     (b)     To meet any other need of the students considered to be genuine by the college
  authority. A student requiring financial aid shall have to apply to the Principal of the college
  with an income certificate given by the competent authority.
  5. Students’ Association and Co-curricular Activities
  Guwahati College Students’ Union society is the general body of the students of this college.
  Every student of the college is a member of this Society. The office bearers of the union are
  elected annually. The Union endeavors to promote fraternity, mutual understanding, and a
  sense of responsibility among the students and work for the all-round development of the

PROSPECTUS 2023-2024                                                       GUWAHATI COLLEGE
 PROSPECTUS-2023-2024                                                      GUWAHATI COLLEGE

  college. The Union also organizes games and sports, debating, and cultural activities among
  the students, under the guidance of the teachers and the college authority.
  6. The College Magazine
  The Guwahati College Magazine is published annually. The Magazine publishes articles by
  teachers, students, and office staff and reviews of the educational, cultural, social, and sports
  activities of the college. The magazine is edited by a student editor under the supervision of a
  member of the teaching staff. The college also publishes an annual News Bulletin.


  7. Library
  The College has a well-stocked three-storeyed Central library. The library is open from 9:00
  a.m. to 5 p.m. on all days except Sundays and holidays. Students can borrow books from the
  library for two weeks. The library is well equipped with a Xerox machine, internet facility, and
  airy and spacious reading rooms for teachers and students. SOUL 2.0 software is being used
  for library automation. N-List (INFLIBNET) is available in the library. The digital library
  facilitates in viewing and downloading various in-house publications like College Magazine,
  bulletin, etc. The library subscribes to a large number of dailies, weeklies, periodicals, and
  journals on a variety of subjects. Membership to the library, issue/return of books, and
  searching/Referencing of books, all this information can be obtained from the Librarian. Books
  on loan with members can be recalled at any time if necessary. Books kept in the reserve
  section are not issued on loan.


  8. College Notice Board
  All-important notices and information to students are displayed on the Notice Board. Students
  are advised to see the Notice Board regularly.


  9. Career Counselling cum Placement Cell
  Guwahati College has a Career Counselling Cell. The Cell’s objective is to help students in
  seeking employment besides providing vocational guidance. The cell organizes counseling
  sessions with in-house faculty or experts from outside. The cell subscribes to Employment
  News, and Weekly Employment News and displays relevant news on the Notice Board.
  Campus interviews are conducted for placement into various MNCs, Nationalized Bank, etc.


  10. Internal Complaint Committee (ICC)
  The Grievance Redressal Cell and ICC of the college look into the grievance or complaint of
  a teacher/student/parent/staff. A grievance or a complaint can be conveyed in writing to the

  11. NCC
  The college has a full-fledged National Cadet Corps, Army Wing, for both boys and girls.
  Regular training is imparted throughout the year by trained NCC officers. There are many
  award and scholarship schemes for eligible cadets including Vir Chilarai Award, Sahara
  Scholarship etc. It is worth mentioning that NCC ‘C’ Certificate holders have various
  opportunities for Govt. services and for getting scholarships like entry in defense services,
  telecommunications, etc., Youth exchange program, community development, personality
  development, adventure training, and shooting are being taught to the cadets in the regular
  Sunday classes in the college premises. Students willing to join the NCC can contact the
  respective Professors-in-charge after the commencement of the academic session.


  12. NSS
  The National Service Scheme unit of the college is actively engaged in various community
  welfare services. Under this scheme, the college unit has shown its proficiency not only at the
  State or Regional level but also in the National as well as in the International scenario. Students
  desiring to join the NSS can contact the respective Programme Officer after the
  commencement of the academic session.


  13. Sports
  The college maintains a good playground where football, volleyball and cricket are played.
  Students of the college have consistently performed well in inter-college competitions at the
  youth meet organized by GU.


  14. History Study Centre
  The Department of History has started this centre in the year 1999, with a view to popularize
  and promote the study of history.


  15. The Disaster Management Cell
  The college has constituted a Disaster Management Cell. The objective of this cell is to create
  awareness amongst people to face any kind of natural hazard like earthquake, flood, cyclone
  etc. and prepare them to learn to survive such calamities.


  16. Guwahati College Women’s Forum

  The Guwahati College Women’s Forum was set up with the prime objective of helping girl
  students of the college in extra-curricular activities and making women of neighboring areas
  aware of hygiene and socio-economic matters. The forum organizes various programmes
  related to women issues.


  17. Alumni Association
  The college has an Alumni Association. Alumni can enroll as well as communicate through
  our website: www.guwahaticollege.org.in
  19. Mountaineering Club
  The college has a Mountaineering Club registered under Assam Rock and sport Climbing
  Association (ARSCA) affiliated to Indian Mountaineering Foundation. The club was
  established in the year 1985. The aim of the club is to promote adventure sports and
  mountaineering skills among students under the technical support of ARSCA. The club was
  established in the year 1985. The club also organizes adventure camps and basic skills of rock
  climbing regularly


  18. Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Cell
  Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Cell is constituted in the College and has been
  successfully conducting student-centric activities. The cell has been instrumental in facilitating
  industry-institution linkage and trained under NSIC. Students are mentored to engage in Skill
  based activities and develop entrepreneurial temperament.


  19. Institution Innovation Cell (IIC)
  Ministry of education (MOE), Govt. of India has established Innovation Cells in all higher
  educational institutions to systematically foster the culture of Innovation amongst all HEIs.
  The college has initiated an IIC involving a number of faculties, domain experts and students.


  20. Eco Club
  Eco Club, Guwahati College is a part of National green corps (NGC), an initiative of Ministry
  of Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC). The Eco Club works to inculcate
  sustainable and eco-friendly practices in the campus. The Eco Club, Guwahati College has
  been recognized as an Excellent Eco Club by Govt. of Assam for the year 2021-2022.


  21. Electoral Literacy Club (ELC)
  Through ELCs, Election Commission of India, aims at strengthening the culture of electoral

  participation among young and future voters. Through the ELC, the college engages college
  students to familiarize them with the electoral process. The club has faculty members as
  conveners and student members as campus ambassadors.


  22. Ecotreato
  It is a platform for direct sales and promotion of handmade products and services initiated by
  the Department of Economics. Through this platform, assistance and support is provided to
  students who wishes to trade in any kinds of handmade products and services.
  23. Yoga and Meditation Cell
  Guwahati College has been running a Yoga and Meditation Centre in the college. The Yoga
  and Meditation Centre was started for both students and staff with a lot of objectives to
  understand the importance of maintaining good health, both physically and mentally, to have
  an understanding of life and peaceful living, to educate students on the spiritual dimension and
  how it affects our lives, to teach through yoga methods of warding of unnecessary stress and
  improving concentration. The Yoga and Meditation Centre conducts sessions on both
  theoretical and practical aspects of yoga and meditation.


  24. Science orientation centre for undergraduate students:
  The main goal of this centre is to motivate the undergraduate students towards research. This
  centre also incubates various scientific ideas at grassroot level. Time to time various workshops
  is organized under SOCUS for the school students to develop scientific temperament among
  them.
  25. Incubation Centre:
  Guwahati College has an incubation center to promote entrepreneurship growth among
  students and the community. The center organizes awareness campaigns, seminars, lectures,
  and industry visits and offers guidance on obtaining loans and financial aid from public and
  private institutions for budding entrepreneurs.
